subject: CONTROL clause
notes: cite.py --check 13.18.16.4 "Therefore FINAL, if specified, is associated with the highest level in the hierarchy" -> OK §13.18.16.4 2). FINAL is registered as a control whose value never changes (get = "", set = no-op) and DetectBreakLevel skips IsFinal, so it never breaks during GENERATE; its CF prints only at TERMINATE's most-major break (probe gr4/f3: `CFF B` once, after CFN/CFX, at TERMINATE). For every format-legal CONTROL clause FINAL is written first, so model.Controls[0] (the highest level) is FINAL. The out-of-position FINAL the grammar also admits is a FORMAT violation owned by FMT-13.18.16.2 / finding 1, not a GR2 defect.
